# Pattern Draft Lab

## Project guidance
- This is an original educational pattern-drafting prototype. Do not copy code, assets, or branding from third-party apps.
- Keep unit conversion, geometry, and SVG serialization in pure domain modules, separate from React presentation.
- Use millimeters internally and validate finite, positive dimensions and non-negative seam allowance.
- Add Vitest coverage for domain calculations and SVG output.
